notes: Canonical ClientFlow 1.3.23 release containing the completed two-phase factory/customer fresh-install lifecycle: office-side 01 Klient klargøring provisions clientflow-kiosk and cfadmin, scrubs factory network profiles and hands off the no-sudo 02 Aktiver ClientFlow flow; the customer path is exact-release-bound, resumable on ambiguous claim outcomes, enters pending_manual_activation, shows the approval-gated legacy-layout preactivation GUI and automatically activates after backend approval.

The release also contains the database/request consolidation, direct browser-to-backend API transport and auth-route churn closures. Production acceptance measured the direct transport at 125.4 ms median for /clients/ versus 840.9 ms through the former Render rewrite, and 119 ms for /chrome-status versus 427.6 ms, while preserving the existing auth, Terminal, Remote Desktop and Livestream trust boundaries.

Fresh install and in-place update remain bounded to the safe ClientFlow 1.3.11 baseline. Ubuntu Desktop 26.04 LTS amd64/Wayland platform preflight remains mandatory, rollback remains disabled and the controlled reboot lifecycle remains required.
